categories.name: Ante
categories.rule: Cards that reference playing for ante are banned.

categories.name: Conspiracy
categories.rule: Cards with the card type Conspiracy are banned.

categories.name: Offensive content
categories.rule: Cards whose art, text or name is racially or culturally offensive are banned.

categories.name: Stickers and Attractions
categories.rule: Cards that bring stickers or Attractions into play are banned.

pool_exclusions.name: Collectors' and International Edition
pool_exclusions.note: Square-bordered gift-set reprints; never tournament legal. Every card in them is a reprint of a card that was legal from Limited Edition, so excluding them changes no card's legality.

pool_exclusions.name: Silver-bordered and acorn
pool_exclusions.note: Unglued onward. Never tournament legal in any format.

pool_exclusions.name: Digital-only
pool_exclusions.note: Astral Cards onward, through Magic Online and Arena/Alchemy. No paper printing, so never legal in paper Vintage.

change_kinds.banned_restricted: a card was restricted, unrestricted, banned or unbanned
change_kinds.errata: a card's wording was changed, which can alter the format without any B&R action
change_kinds.rules: a rules or policy change, such as a mulligan rule
change_kinds.format: the format itself changed -- renamed, or a set made legal
change_kinds._note: change_kinds describes what the era's own 'changes' text records. boundary_kinds describes the events that BOUND the era, which is not the same thing: an era bounded by an errata did not necessarily contain one.

eras.name: Wild Era
eras.changes: No Mandatory Banned and Restricted List, Only Alpha/Beta/Unlimited and first expansion set, Arabian Nights.

eras.name: Degenerate Era
eras.changes: First Mandatory Banned and Restricted List Announced January 26, 1994 and format dubbed "Constructed decks."

eras.name: Constructed Magic Begins
eras.changes: Orcish Oriflame & Rukh Egg unrestricted in February and issued errata.

eras.name: Antiquities Arrives
eras.changes: Channel, Copy Artifact, Demonic Tutor, Regrowth, and Wheel of Fortune restricted. Time Vault banned. Icy Manipulator unrestricted.

eras.name: Library of Alexandria Era
eras.changes: Library of Alexandria, Feldon's Cane, Ivory Tower, and Candleabra of Tawnos restricted. Bronze Tablet banned. Dingus Egg and Gauntlet of Might unrestricted.

eras.name: Mind Twist Metagame
eras.changes: Mishra's Workshop restricted June 13, Legends legal June 10.

eras.name: Creatureless Era Begins
eras.changes: All-land/no-land Mulligan rule adopted. Chaos Orb, Falling Star, Mind Twist, Mirror Universe, Recall, Sword of the Ages, and Underworld Dream restricted. Divine Intervention and Tempest Efreet banned. First US National Championship held at Origins July 7-10.

eras.name: Golden Age of Type 1
eras.changes: "Constructed deck" format rebranded as "Type 1" on January 10, 1995.

eras.name: "The Deck" Dominates
notable_printings: Mystic Remora. Mana Crypt book promo redemption now possible

eras.name: Prelude to Bannings
eras.changes: Chaos Orb and Channel banned.

eras.name: Necro Winter
eras.changes: Mind Twist banned. Black Vise restricted.

eras.name: Type II Havoc
eras.changes: Ali from Cairo, Black Vise, and Sword of the Ages unresticted. Time Vault unbanned and errated.

eras.name: Force of Will Era Begins
eras.changes: Fastbond restricted.

eras.name: Prosperty Combo Era
eras.changes: Black Vise re-restricted.

eras.name: Inquest Summer
eras.changes: Paris Mulligan adopted. Mishra's Workshop, Candelabra of Tawnos, Copy Artifact, Feldon's Cane, and Zuran Orb are unrestricted.

eras.name: Blue Zoo Moment
eras.changes: Strip Mine restricted.

eras.name: Type 1 is Broken: Combo Rising
eras.changes: Tolarian Academy, Windfall, and Stroke of Genius restricted

eras.name: A Jarring Month
eras.changes: Memory Jar and Time Spiral restricted, Maze of Ith unrestricted.

eras.name: Academy's Swan Song
eras.changes: 18 cards restricted. Divine Intervention and Shahrazad unbanned. Ivory Tower, Mirror Universe, and Underworld Dreams unrestricted.

eras.name: Trix Dominant
eras.changes: Channel & Mind Twist Unbanned. Demonic Consultation and Necropotence restricted.

eras.name: The Final Chapter on Fact or Fiction
eras.changes: Fact or Fiction restricted.

eras.name: 1st Gush Era
eras.changes: Earthcraft and Entomb restricted. Hurkyl's Recall, Berserk, and Recall unrestricted.

eras.name: 1st Gush Era Continues
eras.changes: Gush and Mind's Desire restricted.

eras.name: Burning Tendrils Flames Out
eras.changes: Lion's Eye Diamond, Burning Wish and Chrome Mox restricted.

eras.name: The End of Type 1
eras.changes: "Type 1" is rebranded "Vintage." Doomsday, Fork, Braingesyer, and Earthcraft unrestricted.

eras.name: Oath on Top
eras.changes: Stroke of Genius unrestricted.

eras.name: Trinisphere's Last Stand
eras.changes: In addition to Trinisphere's restriction, it is announced that Imperial Seal and Personal tutor will be restricted 6 months later, and that Portal, Portal Second Age, Portal Three Kingdoms, and Starter (1999 and 2000) will become legal for sanctioned play in the Vintage.

eras.name: Meandeck Gifts
eras.changes: Portal and Starter sets legalized in Vintage. Imperial Seal and Personal Tutor restricted. Mind Over Matter unrestricted.

eras.name: The Most Diverse Vintage Format Ever?
Dredge Emerges
eras.changes: Time Vault receives errata, neutering combination with Flame Fusillade.

citation.label: Ask Wizards April 2006 With Time Vault Discussion

eras.name: Pitch Long Emerges
eras.changes: Wizards Announces Policy Change, and Removal of Power-Level Errata.

eras.name: The Mean Deck Metagame
eras.changes: Flash is issued errata with the Oracle update for Future Sight (5/15/2007).

eras.name: Flash Breaks Out
eras.changes: Gifts Ungiven Restricted. Gush, Black Vise, Mind Twist, and Voltaic Key unrestricted.

eras.name: 2nd Gush Era Begins
eras.changes: Shahrazad banned in September.

eras.name: End of the 2nd Gush Era
eras.changes: Brainstorm, Gush, Merchant Scroll, Flash and Ponder restricted.

eras.name: The Storm Before the Tezzeret
eras.changes: Time Vault errataed and restored to its original ruled functionality. Chrome Mox, Dream Halls, Mox Diamond, Personal Tutor, Time Spiral unrestricted. Time Vault restricted.

eras.name: Tezzeret's Final Straw
eras.changes: Thirst for Knowledge restricted. Crop Rotation, Enlightened Tutor, Entomb, and Grim Monolith unrestricted.

eras.name: Confidant Tezzeret Era
eras.changes: Magic 2010 Rules Changes neuter many Vintage cards, like Research/Development and Wish cycle.

eras.name: Jace Controls Format
eras.changes: Gush and Frantic Search unrestricted.

eras.name: Grudging the Metagame
notable_printings: Laboratory Maniac. Fact or Fiction unrestricted

eras.name: Delver Dominates
eras.changes: Treasure Cruise Restricted, Gifts Ungiven Unrestricted.

eras.name: Hangarback Shops Arrive
eras.changes: Chalice of the Void, Dig Through Time restricted. Thirst for Knowledge unrestricted.

eras.name: The Magic Online Power Nine Challenge Begins
eras.changes: Vancouver Mulligan adopted.

eras.name: Gush Swan Song
eras.changes: Gush and Gitaxian Probe restricted.

eras.name: Mentor and Workshops Duopoly
eras.changes: Thorn of Amethyst and Monastery Mentor restricted. Yawgmoth's Bargain unrestricted.

eras.name: Workshops & Oath Metagame
eras.changes: 5 Workshop + 3 Oath decks in Top 8 at NA Vintage Champs. Planeswalker rule change.

eras.name: Big Three Era: Outcome, Workshops, and Turbo Xerox
Survival Breaks Out
notable_printings: Assassin's Trophy. Survival wins the Asian Vintage Championship

citation.label: North America Vintage Champs 2018 Coverage, Decklists, and Results

eras.name: Outcome Test Drives the London Mulligan

citation.label: London Mulligan Tested for 3 Weeks on MTGO

eras.name: BUG Dominant
eras.changes: London mulligan adopted. Mystic Forge, Karn the Great Creator, Golgari Grave-Troll, and Mental Misstep restricted. Fastbond unrestricted.

citation.label: London Mulligan Formally Adopted Across All Formats

eras.name: The Oko Moment
eras.changes: Narset, Parter of the Veil restricted.

eras.name: The Trifecta Format (Outcome, Dredge, and BUG)
Breach Breaks Out
eras.changes: Notable Printin: Lurrus of the Dream Den, Zirda, the Dawnwaker, Lutri, The Spellchaser, Sprite Dragon.

eras.name: Cat Scratch Fever
eras.changes: Lurrus of the Dream-Den banned.

eras.name: Post Lurrus Metagame
eras.changes: Companion Rules Overhauled.

eras.name: Doomsday Dominant
eras.changes: Noteable Printings: Hullbreacher, Opposition Agent, Archon of Emeria

eras.name: GolosShops Rising
eras.changes: Lurrus unbanned

eras.name: Breach Back On Top
eras.changes: Noteable Printing: Sedgemoor Witch, Expressive Iteration

eras.name: Big Blue Falls off a Cliff; Doomsday & Hogaak Rise

eras.changes: Sheoldred

eras.name: Oath Responds and Jewel Shops Wins US EW

eras.changes: Ponder is unrestricted
Vexing Bauble and Urza's Saga Restricted
